title: Finance Manager
description:
Description:
This role is in support of enterprise forecasting solution that aggregates data from multiple Front of House (FOH) systems. Data is enriched in Snowflake and transferred to other systems for planning and analysis. The Financial Service Team oversees an independent data process audit, ensuring documented transformation rules match other system data for specific metrics and time periods.
This contractor role focuses on executing hands-on validation, including ingesting source extracts, rebuilding logic using Alteryx and/or AI-assisted tools (like Cursor AI and Snowflake Cortex AI ), comparing results from source to destination system, and documenting variances for remediation by Technical Teams. Root-cause analysis is handled by Technology partners after variances are reported. The role covers approximately 16 FOH systems and over 1,000 metrics, with assignments managed by Finance.
Contractors will work in a matrixed environment with Finance leads and Technology teams.

Key responsibilities include building repeatable workflows, performing independent audits, leveraging AI toolsets for analysis, documenting variances, participating in re-test cycles, and ensuring consistent output standards. Attention to detail, reproducible workflows, and strong written communication are essential.

Basic Qualifications
  • 3+ years' experience in data analysis, ETL, or financial/operational reporting, especially data reconciliation or audit validation.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Alteryx Designer (or equivalent ETL/data prep tool) and/or experience with AI-assisted analytics tools for workflow and QA on large datasets.
  • Practical experience with AI toolsets (Cursor AI, Snowflake Cortex AI) for workflow development, SQL/analysis, and variance documentation, with rigorous review of AI outputs.
  • Ability to work from written mapping specifications and business rules.
  • Strong SQL or query skills to validate extracts and work with database-sourced data.
  • Excellent written communication, attention to detail, and ability to explain discrepancies clearly.
  • Comfort with fast-paced timelines and multiple source systems.
  • Ability to work U.S. business hours and collaborate with Orlando-area stakeholders.

Tooling & Environment
  • Primary: Alteryx Designer, AI-assisted tools (Cursor AI, Snowflake Cortex AI), Microsoft Excel, file extracts, and mapping information from Tech.
  • Secondary: Smart View/EPM exports, possible SQL against approved sources.
  • Deliverables must be maintainable, reproducible, and aligned to client data security standards.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Oracle EPM Cloud, Smart View, or Excel-based planning/reporting extracts.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, cloud data warehouses, and finance/hospitality metrics.
  • Prior work in regulated or audit-oriented data validation (SOX-adjacent, internal audit support, migration validation).
  • Experience with enterprise data prep platforms (Dataiku, Alteryx) and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Alteryx Designer Core or Advanced certification (or equivalent portfolio).

Education
• Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

Must have previous Provider data experience working with leadership on provider data issues, accuracy, and provider data interactions with claims and claims platforms. Knowledge of Salesforce and Facets is required.

Previous demonstrable experience with reporting to leadership and working remotely with teams is preferred.
